Notes: Turner 9383 bhánati directly cites European Romani phen- 'to speak'. The source prints the Zargari present stem phen- in productive infinitive phenipej 'to say; to tell' (p. 142 §3.17.3.1), already linked to 9383. It separately gives te-phen-es > ti-phen-is 'you should say' under vowel harmony (p. 129 §2.3.26), mé-phen 'Do not say!' with stressed prohibitive mā- (p. 130 §2.5.3), and ne-phendom 'I did not say' under negative particle nā-/ne- (p. 144 §3.20.4.1). All three are ordinary source-parsed inflections of the same inherited phen- stem, with local mood/negation retained. The te-phen-es spelling already has a compiled rank-1 variant edge to ti-phen-is and is not duplicated. Original PDF, glyph-decoded source audit and imported key checked; no transcription or identity change. Zargari say-verb mood and negation; source PDF, audit and CDIAL corroborated
